about.heroDesc: Dedicated to the R&D and production of lightweight aggregate concrete, driving green building material innovation
about.aboutText1: Founded in 2000, YouDing Building Materials Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the R&D, production, and sales of lightweight aggregate concrete. Located in the China Building Materials Industrial Park, the company covers an area of over 100,000 square meters with modern production bases and R&D centers.
about.aboutText2: The company has introduced internationally advanced production equipment and testing instruments, established a comprehensive quality management system, and products fully comply with the GB/T 17431-2010 "Lightweight Aggregate Concrete" standard. With an annual production capacity exceeding 1 million tons, our products are widely used in various construction projects, bridges and tunnels, thermal insulation, and other fields.
about.aboutText3: The company has always adhered to technological innovation as its core driving force, established long-term partnerships with multiple renowned universities and research institutes, and holds over 30 invention and utility model patents.

about.intro1: Founded in 2010, YouDing Building Materials is a high-tech enterprise integrating R&D, production, sales and technical services of new building materials.
about.intro2: Our main products include lightweight aggregate concrete, ceramsite concrete, insulation mortar, and special mortar series, widely used in residential, commercial, public building and municipal engineering projects.
about.intro3: With advanced production equipment and a professional technical team, we have an annual capacity of 500,000 cubic meters, serve over 500 clients, and have delivered more than 2 million cubic meters cumulatively.
about.intro4: We always uphold the business philosophy of 'Quality as Foundation, Innovation as Soul', committed to providing clients with quality products and professional solutions.

news.bannerSubtitle: Stay informed with industry news and company updates

news1.title: YouDing Launches New High-Performance Lightweight Aggregate Concrete CL40
news1.summary: After 18 months of R&D, the company successfully launched CL40 high-strength lightweight aggregate concrete with LC40 strength grade and density controlled within 1,800kg/m³, filling a domestic gap.

news2.title: YouDing at 2026 China Green Building Expo
news2.summary: The company showcased its full range of green building materials at the 2026 China Green Building Expo, demonstrating lightweight aggregate concrete applications in ultra-low energy buildings.

news3.title: Ministry of Housing Issues New Lightweight Aggregate Concrete Industry Standard
news3.summary: The Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development officially released the new 'Technical Specification for Lightweight Aggregate Concrete', setting higher requirements for raw materials, mix design and construction processes.

news4.title: YouDing Celebrates 15th Anniversary
news4.summary: The company's 15th anniversary celebration was held at headquarters, reviewing the development journey and recognizing outstanding employees and long-term partners.

news5.title: YouDing's Second Automated Production Line Officially Put into Operation
news5.summary: The second fully automated production line with German advanced equipment has completed commissioning and officially started operation, increasing annual capacity to 500,000 cubic meters.

news6.title: Building Insulation Materials Market Outlook: Green and Low-Carbon Becomes Mainstream
news6.summary: As the 'dual carbon' strategy advances, the building insulation materials industry is seeing new opportunities, with green, low-carbon and energy-efficient solutions driving growing demand.

news7.title: YouDing Passes ISO14001 Environmental Management System Recertification
news7.summary: The company successfully passed the annual ISO14001 environmental management system recertification, maintaining international standards in environmental protection and sustainable development.

news8.title: Complete Guide to Winter Lightweight Aggregate Concrete Construction
news8.summary: Our technical team has compiled a detailed construction guide for lightweight aggregate concrete in low-temperature winter conditions, covering material insulation, mix adjustments and curing measures.
